objectives.description: Classify occurrences by signature (accounted vs corrupted)

approaches_tried.approach: Literal adjacent-character (15 stripped chars each side) anchor for per-occurrence classification
approaches_tried.reason: baier_katoen_2008 corrupts SEVERAL adjacent math symbols at once (parallel-bar, prime), not just the negation mark, so literal adjacent-symbol anchors break; only ~440/819 classified confidently, ~375 unanchored

approaches_tried.approach: Plain-ASCII-word landmark anchoring (nearest run of >=4 letters each side) with raw-character gap-length slack
approaches_tried.reason: raw PDF character distances diverge from markdown distances whenever dehyphenation/soft-wrap-rejoin crosses a line break between the anchor word and the target; produced many false ambiguous/ null matches

approaches_tried.approach: Word-landmark anchoring with whitespace-NORMALIZED distance (collapse all whitespace runs to 1 char) plus a post-filter requiring the matched gap actually contain the base character or its precomposed target
approaches_tried.reason: resolved both false-ambiguity (unrelated same-length word pairs elsewhere in the document) and false-anchor-not-found (line-break-crossing distance skew); verified against all four Phase 1 spot-check documents (rabinovich_2014 negative control: 0 corrupted; verbrugge_2004: mostly accounted; schwoon_esparza_2005: correctly classified glyph_six; bacon_2018: 16/18 confidently control_char)
